scope: observed native main engine commands; current host schema and enabled state remain authoritative

commands.label: New Presentation
commands.params: {theme?: name, template?: starter name, size?: [w,h] pt, blank?: bool}

commands.label: Open
commands.params: {path, token?} (a presentation the host read in the background and staged with Session::stage_loaded; without one, reads path like file.open)

commands.label: Export…
commands.params: {path, format?: png|jpeg|pptx|deckcraft|outline|pdf|gif (else by path), slide?: index, all?: bool, scale?: px per pt, layout?: slides|notes|handouts (pdf), perPage?: 1|2|3|4|6|9, paper?: letter|a4|legal|a3 (pdf), orientation?: portrait|landscape (pdf), dpi?, slides?: [index]|range ("1-3,5"), includeHidden?, textLayer?, frame?, width?: px 16-3840|small|medium|large|extraLarge (gif), secondsPerSlide?: 0.1-600 (gif; 5), loop?: bool (gif; true: forever)} → {path, bytes} or {files} (png, jpeg); gif adds frames, width, height, secondsPerSlide

commands.label: Info
commands.params: {} → {title, path, format, dirty, slides, hiddenSlides, sections, bytes?, properties}

commands.label: Render Slide
commands.params: {slide?: index, scale?, edit?: bool} → {png: base64, width, height}

commands.label: Color At
commands.params: {slide?: index, x, y (slide units), scale?: px per unit (2)} → {color: "RRGGBB", alpha: 0..255, x, y}: the colour drawn at a point of the slide (the Eyedropper)

commands.label: Properties
commands.params: {title?, subject?, author?, keywords?, comments?, category?, company?} → properties

commands.label: Paste
commands.params: {text?: plain text to paste, html?: rich text from another app, scope?: slides}

commands.label: Paste Special
commands.params: {as: destinationTheme|keepSource|picture|text} — Use Destination Theme, Keep Source Formatting, Picture (PNG), Keep Text Only

commands.label: New Slide
commands.params: {layout?: layout name or kind (title, titleAndContent, sectionHeader, twoContent, comparison, titleOnly, blank, contentWithCaption, pictureWithCaption), at?: index, title?: text, body?: text}

commands.label: Notes
commands.params: {text | body: formatted notes (as in slide.inspect's notesBody), index?} (text as typed: untouched notes keep their formatting)

commands.label: Slides from Outline…
commands.params: {text, markdown?: bool (headings are slides, list items bullets)}

commands.label: Reuse Slides…
commands.params: {path? | data: base64, name?, slides?: [index] (0-based, default all), keepFormatting?: bool (default false: use the destination theme), at?: index (default after the current slide)}

commands.label: Photo Album…
commands.params: {pictures?: [{path?|data: base64, name?, rot?: deg, brightness?: -1..1, contrast?: -1..1} | {text}], layout?: fit|1|2|4|1title|2title|4title, frame?: none|rect|rounded|simple, captions?: bool, grayscale?: bool, theme?: name} — omit pictures to open the dialog

commands.label: Edit Photo Album…
commands.params: {album?: id, pictures?: same as insert.photoAlbum, layout?, frame?, captions?, grayscale?, theme?} — omit pictures to reopen the dialog on the current album

commands.label: Date & Time
commands.params: {format?: datetime1..datetime13, update?: bool, language?: en-US|en-GB|fr-FR|ja-JP|sv-SE} — no keys opens the dialog

commands.label: Action Settings
commands.params: {on?: click|hover, action: none|next|previous|first|last|lastViewed|endShow|playMedia|slide|url|customShow|program, slide?: index, url?, show?: custom show name, path?, highlight?: bool, tooltip?, ids?}

commands.label: Link
commands.params: {url? | slide?: index, tooltip?, text?: shown when nothing is selected, highlightClick?, ids?}

commands.label: Edit Data
commands.params: {categories?: [..], levels?: [[..]] (outer category levels, innermost first), series?: [{name, values}], id?}

commands.label: Chart Elements
commands.params: {title?: string|null, legend?: b|t|l|r|null, dataLabels?: bool, gridlines?: bool, palette?, binCount?: n|null, binSize?: n|null, subtotals?: [point index], quartiles?: exclusive|inclusive, upDownBars?: bool, id?}

commands.label: Text Pane
commands.params: {id?} → {id, kind, nodes: [{text, level}]} (id: the SmartArt group or one of its shapes; default the selection)

commands.label: Edit SmartArt Text
commands.params: {id?, nodes?: [{text, level}], lines?: [string] (leading tabs set the level), index?, text?, title?} (index + text edits one node; title: its Name and Title box)

commands.label: Add Shape
commands.params: {id?, index?, position?: after|before|below|above|assistant, text?} → {index} (default: after the last node)

commands.label: Remove Shape
commands.params: {id?, index} (its sub-points move up one level)

commands.label: Convert to SmartArt
commands.params: {id?, kind?} → {id} (a text box or placeholder becomes a SmartArt graphic in its place: one node per paragraph, indent levels kept)

commands.label: Convert to Text
commands.params: {id?} → {id} (the graphic becomes a text box of its outline, bulleted by level)

commands.label: Convert to Shapes
commands.params: {id?} (the graphic becomes a plain group of its shapes; the outline is dropped)

commands.label: Insert Picture in SmartArt
commands.params: {id?, index, data?: base64 | path?: string | reset?: bool} (the node's picture placeholder in picture layouts)

commands.label: Connect Shapes
commands.params: {from: shape id, to: shape id, fromSite?, toSite?: site index (default: the closest pair), id?: existing line to glue (else a new connector), preset?: straightConnector1|bentConnector3|curvedConnector3} → {id}

commands.label: Freeform
commands.params: {points: [[x, y], …] slide pt (≥ 2), closed?: bool (filled shape), smooth?: bool (curve through the points)} → {id}

commands.label: Ink to Shape
commands.params: {} → {shapes: [ids], kept: n} turns recognisable ink strokes on the slide into lines, rectangles, ellipses and triangles

commands.label: Connection Sites
commands.params: {id} → [[x, y]] connection sites in slide points

commands.label: Move
commands.params: {dx?: pt (relative), dy?: pt (relative), ids?} | {x?: pt (absolute), y?: pt (absolute), ids?}

commands.label: Size
commands.params: {w?: pt, h?: pt, lockAspect?: bool, ids?}

commands.label: Rotation
commands.params: {deg?: absolute, by?: relative, ids?, gesture?: move|end}

commands.label: Size and Position…
commands.params: {x?, y?: pt, w?, h?: pt, rot?: deg, scaleW?, scaleH?: percent of the current size (100 = unchanged), lockAspect?: bool, ids?} — with none of those keys, opens the dialog

commands.label: Smooth Corners
commands.params: {smoothing: 0..100 (%), radius?: pt (default: the rounded rectangle's own), ids?} → rectangle outline with smoothed (squircle) corners

commands.label: Shape Fill
commands.params: {color? | none?: true | gradient?: {stops: [[pos, color]], angle?, kind?: linear|radial} | picture?: base64 | pattern?: {preset, fg, bg} | transparency?: 0..1 | reset?: true, ids?}; pictureProps?: {tile?: bool, offsetX?, offsetY?: pt, scaleX?, scaleY?: 0..10, align?: tl|t|tr|l|ctr|r|bl|b|br, mirror?: none|x|y|xy, stretch?: [l, t, r, b] fractions, rotateWithShape?: bool} adjusts a picture fill

commands.label: Shape Outline
commands.params: {color?, none?, width?: pt, dash?: solid|dot|dash|lgDash|dashDot|sysDot|sysDash, cap?: flat|round|square, join?: round|bevel|miter, compound?: single|double|thickThin|thinThick|triple, head?: none|triangle|stealth|diamond|oval|arrow, tail?, headSize?: sm|med|lg, tailSize?, reset?, ids?}

commands.label: Shape Effects
commands.params: {shadow?: none|outer|inner|perspective|{color, blur, dist, dir}, glow?: none|{color, radius}, softEdges?: pt, reflection?: none|tight|half|full, bevel?: none|circle|…, threeD?: {camera?: preset, rotX?, rotY?, rotZ?: deg, z?: pt, bevelTop?, bevelBottom?: none|circle|…, bevelTopW?, bevelTopH?, bevelBottomW?, bevelBottomH?, depth?, contour?: pt, material?, lighting?, reset?: true}, shadowProps?: {color?, transparency?: 0..1, blur?: pt, dist?: pt, dir?: deg}, glowProps?: {color?, transparency?, radius?: pt}, reflectionProps?: {transparency?, size?: 0..1, dist?: pt, blur?: pt}, reset?, ids?} (the *Props keys adjust the current effect, adding a default one when there is none)

commands.label: Lock
commands.params: {locked?: bool (default: toggle), ids?} (a group locks or unlocks with everything in it)

commands.label: Crop
commands.params: {left?: fraction 0..1, top?: fraction 0..1, right?: fraction 0..1, bottom?: fraction 0..1, ids?}

commands.label: Corrections
commands.params: {brightness?: -1..1, contrast?: -1..1, saturation?: 0..4, grayscale?: bool, transparency?: 0..1, reset?: bool, ids?}

commands.label: Playback
commands.params: {autoplay?, loop?, rewind?, acrossSlides?, hide?, fullScreen?, volume?: 0..1, trimStart?: ms, trimEnd?: ms, fadeIn?: ms, fadeOut?: ms, ids?}

commands.label: Remove Background
commands.params: {tolerance?: 0..100 (how different a colour may be from the edge's, default 20), ids?}

commands.label: Set Transparent Color
commands.params: {color: #RRGGBB | none: true, ids?} (pixels of that colour become transparent)

commands.label: Add Guide
commands.params: {vertical: bool, pos?: pt (default: the slide's centre)} → {index}. `defaults: true` adds the two centre guides when there are none

commands.label: Reorder Objects
commands.params: {id, index: position among its siblings (0 = back; a group's child stays in its group)} → {index}

commands.label: Align
commands.params: {edge: left|center|right|top|middle|bottom, to?: slide|selection (default: slide for one object), ids?}

commands.label: Nudge
commands.params: {dx, dy, ids?} (arrow keys: 6 pt, with Alt 1 pt)

commands.label: Select
commands.params: {ids | id, toggle?: bool (Ctrl+click), add?: bool} → {selected}: objects in groups too; a hidden object picked from the list is shown

commands.label: Show All
commands.params: {} shows every object on the slide, inside groups too

commands.label: Hide All
commands.params: {} hides every top-level object on the slide

commands.label: Merge Shapes
commands.params: {op: union|combine|fragment|intersect|subtract, ids?: shapes in selection order (the first one's formatting is kept)} → {ids}

commands.label: Edit Points
commands.params: {on?: bool (default: toggle), id?} — enter or leave Edit Points for one selected shape; entering turns a preset into a freeform

commands.label: Points
commands.params: {id?} → {id, paths: [[[x, y] slide pt]], types: [[smooth|straight|corner]]} vertices of a freeform

commands.label: Move Point
commands.params: {path?: 0, index, x, y: slide pt, id?}

commands.label: Add Point
commands.params: {path?: 0, segment: index of the vertex ending it, t?: 0..1 (0.5), id?}

commands.label: Point Type
commands.params: {path?: 0, index, type: smooth|straight|corner, id?} — smooth: handles in line and equal; straight: in line; corner: independent

commands.label: Move Handle
commands.params: {path?: 0, index, side: in|out, x, y: slide pt, type?: smooth|straight|corner (default: read from the handles), id?}

commands.label: Replace Fonts
commands.params: {from, to} — every explicit use of family `from`, theme fonts included → {replaced}

commands.label: Edit Text
commands.params: {id?, at?: [paragraph, char], end?: bool, cell?: [row, col], notes?: bool}

commands.label: AutoCorrect Options
commands.params: {on?, twoInitials?, sentenceCaps?, days?, capsLock?, fractions?: bool, add?: [from, to], remove?: from} → the options and the replacement list

commands.label: Compose Text
commands.params: {text, active?: [start, end]} — an input method's composition (preedit) at the insertion point; empty text cancels it

commands.label: Commit Composition
commands.params: {text} — the input method's result replaces its composition, as one undo step

commands.label: Delete Text
commands.params: {dir?: backward|forward|wordBackward|wordForward} — the word directions are Ctrl+Backspace/Delete: they work from the start of a selection without deleting it

commands.label: Move Insertion Point
commands.params: {to: left|right|up|down|wordLeft|wordRight|lineStart|lineEnd|paraStart|paraEnd|paraUp|paraDown|start|end, extend?: bool} — left/right are on screen: in a right-to-left paragraph left goes forward

commands.label: Set Text
commands.params: {id?, text, cell?: [r, c]} — replaces the whole text, keeping the first run's formatting

commands.label: Add Font
commands.params: {data: base64 TTF/OTF/TTC} → {faces} added for this session

commands.label: Text Transparency
commands.params: {value: 0..1} — 0 opaque, 1 invisible; keeps the text's colour (inherited colours included)

commands.label: Language
commands.params: {lang?, noProof?: bool} (proofing language of the selected text, and Do Not Check Spelling)

commands.label: Change Case
commands.params: {mode?: cycle|sentence|lower|upper|title|toggle} — cycle (Shift+F3, the default) goes lowercase → Capitalize Each Word → UPPERCASE; a caret in a word changes that word

commands.label: Font…
commands.params: {family?, size?: pt, bold?: bool, italic?: bool, underline?: none|sng|dbl|heavy|dotted|dash|wavy, color?, strike?: none|sng|dbl, baseline?: none|super|sub|<fraction>, caps?: none|small|all, spacing?: pt} — with none of these, opens the Font dialog

commands.label: Text Transform
commands.params: {preset: a prstTxWarp name or none, adj?: [finite raw guide values, at most 8]} — none clears the transform; omitted adj uses the preset's defaults

commands.label: Right-to-Left Text Direction
commands.params: {on?: bool} (off = left-to-right; switching mirrors left/right alignment)

commands.label: Bullets
commands.params: {on?: bool, char?: •|○|■|□|◆|➢|✓|–, color?, size?: % of text}

commands.label: Numbering
commands.params: {on?: bool, scheme?: arabicPeriod|arabicParenR|romanUcPeriod|romanLcPeriod|alphaUcPeriod|alphaLcParenR|alphaLcPeriod, start?: n, color?, size?: % of text}

commands.label: Paragraph…
commands.params: {align?, indentLeft?: pt, indentFirst?: pt (negative = hanging), spaceBefore?: pt, spaceAfter?: pt, lineSpacing?: lines}

commands.label: Ruler
commands.params: {} → {x, y, width, rotated, marginLeft, indent, tabs: [{pos, align}], defaultTab} for the paragraph with the caret (x, y: the text area's top-left in slide pt)

commands.label: Paragraph…
commands.params: {align?: left|center|right|justify|justLow|distributed, indentLeft?: pt, indentRight?: pt, special?: none|first|hanging, specialBy?: pt, indentFirst?: pt, spaceBefore?: pt, spaceAfter?: pt, spaceBeforeKind?: pts|pct, spaceAfterKind?: pts|pct, lineSpacing?: lines, lineSpacingPt?: pt} — with none of these, opens the Paragraph dialog

commands.label: Tabs…
commands.params: {set?: [{pos, align?}] (replaces all), add?: {pos, align?: l|ctr|r|dec}, move?: {from, to}, remove?: pos, clear?: bool, defaultTab?: pt} on the selected paragraphs; with none of them, opens the Tabs dialog (pos in pt from the text area's left)

commands.label: Text Box Margins
commands.params: {left?: pt, top?: pt, right?: pt, bottom?: pt}

commands.label: Formatting State
commands.params: {} → the effective formatting at the selection (font, size, bold, …)

commands.label: Browse for Themes…
commands.params: {path} | {name, data: base64} — apply the theme of a .thmx, .pptx or .potx file

commands.label: Theme Gallery
commands.params: {} → themes, colour schemes, font schemes and effect schemes

commands.label: Variant Gallery
commands.params: {} → the current theme's four colour variants and which is applied

commands.label: Fonts
commands.params: {} opens Create New Theme Fonts | {name} | {major, minor}

commands.label: Format Background
commands.params: {color? | gradient? | picture?: base64 | pattern? | style?: 1..12 | reset?, all?: bool, index?, transparency?: 0..1, pictureProps?: {tile?, offsetX?, offsetY?: pt, scaleX?, scaleY?: 0.01..10, align?, mirror?, stretch?: [l,t,r,b], rotateWithShape?}, copy?: bool}

commands.label: Slide Size
commands.params: {preset: widescreen|standard|…, orientation?: portrait|landscape, scale?: maximize|ensureFit|none} | {w: pt, h: pt, orientation?: portrait|landscape, scale?: maximize|ensureFit|none}

commands.label: Header and Footer…
commands.params: {date?: bool, dateText?: fixed text, slideNumber?: bool, footer?: bool, footerText?, hideOnTitle?: bool, all?: bool (default true)}

commands.label: Handout Master
commands.params: {} (creates the handout master with header, date, footer and page number if the deck has none)

commands.label: Handout Placeholders
commands.params: {header?: bool, date?: bool, footer?: bool, pageNumber?: bool} (show or hide each)

commands.label: Notes Master
commands.params: {} (creates the notes master with header, date, slide image, notes body, footer and page number if the deck has none)

commands.label: Notes Placeholders
commands.params: {header?, date?, slideImage?, body?, footer?, pageNumber?: bool} (show or hide each)

commands.label: Timing
commands.params: {duration?: ms, onClick?: bool, after?: ms | null, index?}

commands.label: Sound
commands.params: {builtin?: chime|click|camera|whoosh|drumRoll|laser | path? | data: base64, name?, none?: true (No Sound), stopPrevious?: true, loop?: bool (Loop Until Next Sound), index?} — the sound plays as the slide comes in

commands.label: Animation Styles
commands.params: {effect: fade|fly|zoom|wipe|appear|spin|pulse|fadeOut|lines|… (animation.list), class?: entrance|emphasis|exit|path, option?, ids?} — replaces the shapes' animations

commands.label: Add Animation
commands.params: {effect, class?, option?, start?: onClick|withPrevious|afterPrevious, duration?: ms, delay?: ms, ids?}

commands.label: Timing
commands.params: {index? (else selected shapes), start?: onClick|withPrevious|afterPrevious, duration?: ms, delay?: ms, repeat?: n, rewind?: bool, trigger?: shape id | null}

commands.label: Split Cells
commands.params: {cell?: [r, c] (else the edited cell), id?} | {row?: index, col?: index, id?}

commands.label: Table Style Options
commands.params: {headerRow?: bool, totalRow?: bool, bandedRows?: bool, firstColumn?: bool, lastColumn?: bool, bandedColumns?: bool, id?}

commands.label: Shading
commands.params: {color? | none?, cells?: [[r,c],…] (default: selected cells or all), id?}

commands.label: Borders
commands.params: {which: all|outside|inside|insideH|insideV|top|bottom|left|right|diagDown|diagUp|none, color?, width?: pt, dash?: solid|dash|dot…, cells?: [[r,c],…] (default: selected cells or all), id?}

commands.label: Cell Margins
commands.params: {preset?: normal|none|narrow|wide, left?, right?, top?, bottom?: pt, cells?, id?}

commands.label: Width
commands.params: {col, width: pt, keepTotal?: bool (the next column absorbs the change), id?}

commands.label: Draw Table
commands.params: {from: [x, y], to: [x, y] slide pt, id?: table (default: the one under `from`)} splits the cells the line crosses

commands.label: Table Eraser
commands.params: {at: [x, y] slide pt, id?, tol?: pt (default 6)} merges the two cells on either side of the nearest border

commands.label: Find
commands.params: {text, matchCase?: bool, wholeWords?: bool} → [{slide, shape (null = notes), cell?: [row, col], para, start, end}] (char offsets in the paragraph)

commands.label: Replace
commands.params: {text, with, matchCase?, wholeWords?, at?: a text.find match (replace just that one; default: replace all)} → {replaced}

commands.label: Spelling
commands.params: {lang?, ignore?:[word]} → [{slide, shape?, row?, col?, notes?, para, start, end, word, lang, suggestions}] (shapes, table cells and notes; repeated words as {repeated, deleteFrom}; runs marked noProof skipped; each run in its own language, lang? for runs without one; Hunspell dictionaries installed on the system, else a built-in list of common misspellings)

commands.label: Change Spelling
commands.params: {shape, word, to, all?, para?, start?, row?, col?} → {changed} (replace the whole word in that shape's text, the one at para/start, or in every shape with all)

commands.label: Add to Dictionary
commands.params: {word} → {word, file} (append to the user dictionary file; not an undo step)

commands.label: Spelling Dictionary
commands.params: {lang?} → {lang, available, found, folders} (whether review.spelling has a dictionary, and which file)

commands.label: Thesaurus
commands.params: {word? (default: the selected word, or the word at the caret)} → {word, senses: [{word, synonyms}]}

commands.label: Insert Synonym
commands.params: {with}: replace the selected word (or the word at the caret) while editing text

commands.label: Compare
commands.params: {path} | {name, data: base64} — compare with a revised copy → {name, changes}

commands.label: Set Up Slide Show…
commands.params: {type?: speaker|browsed|kiosk, loop?: bool, noNarration?, noAnimation?, useTimings?, showMediaControls?, from?, to?, custom?: name}

commands.label: Inspect Presentation
commands.params: {} → slides with titles, layouts, shape counts; selection; size; theme

commands.label: Inspect Slide
commands.params: {index?} → the slide's shapes with ids, kinds, boxes, text, fills, animations, transition, notes (text, and notesBody with its formatting)

commands.label: Inspect Shape
commands.params: {id} → full shape JSON plus its effective box

commands.label: Media Info
commands.params: {id?} → {id, name, contentType, bytes, durationMs, video, width, height, probe: {container, audio?, video?}, options, status?}

commands.label: Zoom
commands.params: {kind?: slide|section|summary (default slide); slides?: [index] (slide and summary zooms); sections?: [index] (section zoom); returnToZoom?: bool (default: on for section and summary, off for slide)}

commands.label: Compress Pictures
commands.params: {ppi?: 330|220|150|96 (default 220), deleteCropped?: bool (default true), all?: bool (every picture in the presentation; default the selected pictures), ids?} → {pictures, before, after}
